other_conditions: Beneficiary can be an Individual, Group of Individuals, Self Help Group, Cooperative Society, or Farmers Producer Organization
For shearing units, the beneficiary must be an individual trained in MSS or intending to undergo training in MSS
Beneficiary must have basic infrastructure and grazing avenues available to maintain the unit
benefits_summary: Beneficiaries receive free ewes and up to 50% subsidy for establishing sheep/goat units or shearing units, subject to cost ceilings per unit.
application_link: Submit Annexure B to the respective District Sheep Husbandry Officer (DSHO)
